_help.purpose: Tracks all 27 enterprise agentic system items across sessions and tools (opencode, cline, etc.).
_help.how_to_resume: Read this file. Find first item with status 'pending' or 'in_progress'. Check branch field and checkout. Continue work.

items.title: Operations PR fix
items.description: Show all PRs (closed + open), CI status badges, branch links in Operations page
items.notes: Created /api/agentic-console/pull-requests route using gh CLI. Enhanced PR table with CI status, review status, state badge, and GitHub link.

items.title: QA dashboard split + Req Quality
items.description: Fix 200% bug, split into 3 sub-pages (KPIs, Tests, Defects), add Req Quality Status table Green/Yellow/Red per REQ-ID, clickable % → traceability
items.notes: Fixed 200% bug. Restructured quality page with 3-tab layout (KPIs/Tests/Defects) with Req Quality Status table.

items.title: Multi-project state directory
items.description: 00_state_ledger/projects/{id}/ per project, projects_index.json, all API routes accept ?project= param
items.ui_surface: Nav bar project dropdown, / route global train view, ?project=X routing
items.notes: Created projects_index.json + projects/petemart/STATE_MATRIX.json. Updated all API routes with ?project= support.

items.title: Dashboard restructure
items.description: Global pipeline view (all projects as mini trains) + per-project dashboard. Project selector. Rename to 'Central Agentic AI Console'
items.notes: GlobalPipelineView shows mini train cards per project. Renamed layout to 'Central Agentic AI Console'.

items.title: Tool/Function registry
items.notes: Generated tool_registry.json with 58 flat tools from MCP_SERVERS.json.

items.title: Supervisor auto-recovery + dependency cascade
items.notes: Extended monitor/route.ts with auto-relaunch, exponential backoff, dependency cascade, DLQ entries.

items.title: Retry policy + Dead Letter Queue
items.notes: DLQ implementation with per-agent retry, exponential backoff, DLQ count badge in instrument bar.

items.title: Escalation matrix
items.notes: Created escalation_matrix.json with 4 severity levels, 5 triggers, 3 channels. ESC badge in instrument bar.

items.title: Agent templates with dependency picker
items.notes: AGENT_TEMPLATES.json with 16 templates. Add Agent modal with dependency picker.

items.title: Versioned outputs + smart cascade
items.notes: Output version API with breaking/backward-compatible cascade in Agent Detail.

items.title: A2A structured message protocol
items.notes: A2A_TYPES.json with 3 message types. Comm tab with type badges and filter.

items.title: Per-agent memory store
items.notes: memory_store/ with per-agent JSONL files. Inject toggle in Overview tab.

items.title: Code review skip fix
items.notes: Diff truncation at 15000 chars. Graceful skip when DEEPSEEK_API_KEY not set.

items.title: Nav + breadcrumbs all pages
items.notes: Breadcrumbs component with path-based crumbs, page labels, ?project= passthrough.

items.title: Jira integration
items.notes: /api/agentic-console/jira endpoint. Jira table in Operations page.

items.title: Agent Grid page polish
items.notes: Inline Approve/Reject, status filter tabs, bulk select with action bar.

items.title: Config/prompt versioning
items.notes: Prompt snapshots with side-by-side compare in Prompts tab.

items.title: SLA tracking
items.notes: /api/agentic-console/sla route. Overdue badge in instrument bar.

items.title: DAG workflow engine
items.notes: WORKFLOW_DAG.json with 15 nodes, conditionals, forks, entry/terminal nodes. /api/agentic-console/dag with walk order computation.

items.title: Recursive sub-task spawning
items.notes: /api/agentic-console/subtasks with spawn/complete actions. Tree view with depth tracking. A2A messages for DelegatedSubTask/SubTaskResult.

items.title: Output evaluation/regression
items.notes: EVAL_RULES.json with 70+ rules across 15 agents. /api/agentic-console/eval-rules with agentId filter.

items.title: Observability / tracing
items.notes: /api/agentic-console/traces route. traces.jsonl storage. Trace toggle in Agent Detail Logs tab.

items.title: Multi-tenant / RBAC
items.notes: /api/agentic-console/rbac with login/logout, add_user, set_role, set_project_access. 3 roles (admin/gatekeeper/viewer). Token-based sessions with 24h expiry.

items.title: Jira auto-sync
items.notes: POST /api/agentic-console/jira with sync/map_agent/transition actions. Agent→Jira mapping. Status transitions (approved→Done, failed→To Do). Sync log.

items.title: GitHub code review in console
items.notes: /api/agentic-console/code-reviews using gh CLI. Code Review section in Agent Detail with PR link and review comments.

items.title: Agent health dashboard
items.notes: /health page with aggregate cards, success rate bar chart (recharts), detailed health table. /api/agentic-console/health backend.

items.title: Inter-agent debate/consensus
items.notes: DebateOpen/DebateResponse/DebateResolution types in A2A_TYPES.json. /api/agentic-console/consensus with open_debate/respond_debate/resolve_debate. Auto-resolves on APPROVE, escalates on REJECT.
